image_description: A guenon monkey (likely a Vervet or similar species) sitting on a wooden beam. The monkey has olive-green fur on its back, white chest and facial ruff, and a black face with white eyebrows. It is facing left. A thick rope hangs in the upper left background. The background is a blurred green mesh fence.

Eyes are forward-facing. Irises appear dark/brown, consistent with the species.
The nose structure is narrow and prominent, typical of Old World monkeys.
Ears are small and partially obscured by the facial ruff, but visible and proportionate.
